data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding at the start of the year were $1,721.8m. On a gross basis the syndicate's prior-year development was effectively flat (no material aggregate gross strengthening or release identified from the gross claims development table). On a net basis the syndicate recorded prior year releases of $57.0m, driven by favourable run-off across most classes, partially offset by adverse development in Specialty (primarily Contingency). COVID-19-related provisions of $49.0m remain in net technical provisions and reinsurance recoveries have influenced the net outcome.
raw_causal_phrases: There has been a reassessment of the net provision for claims outstanding held at the previous year end. The release in 2021 amounted to $57.0m (2020: $42.8m), attributable to the following classes of business:

There has been favourable run-off of prior year business for all classes, other than the Specialty class, which experienced adverse development of $26.1m (2020: favourable run-off of $4.6m), primarily due to the Contingency class.
Net technical provisions includes $49.0m (2020: $128.9m) relating to the COVID-19 pandemic arising primarily in the Contingency class of business.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves taken from balance sheet gross 'Claims outstanding' prior-year comparative. The formal 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' note reports NET releases of $57.0m; however that movement note is explicitly presented as net. A gross claims development triangle (note 14) was used as the primary source for gross prior-year development and shows no material gross movement for underwriting years 2012-2019 (hence prior_year_development_gbp_m = 0.0). Per-class movement figures in the Movement note are net of reinsurance and have been used in lob_movements (confidence reduced). Some class name mappings (e.g. Political Risk / Political Violence -> Reinsurance - Specialty) are approximate.
